package.name: hive_camera_bridge
package.description: ROS 2 camera topic -> WebRTC. Subscribes to the robot's RGB camera and serves it to the browser over WebRTC (aiortc), signaled through hive_api_gateway's /webrtc/offer proxy. Sibling to hive_mqtt_bridge — same "boundary node" role, different protocol (media needs a direct path; MQTT isn't built for bulk real-time video).
